packs.title: Mutants & Meltdowns
packs.about: The world ended in the Big Oops. Now you're a mutant, a beastling, a walking plant, a rusty robot, or just a lucky normal — poking glowing Ancient relics with a stick. Load it, then try a 'Start as...'.

packs.title: Tobin aka Flame Master
packs.about: Tobin the dwarf warlock, his pet dragons Speak and Talk, and everything he needs. Load it, then press 'Start as Tobin aka Flame Master'.
